newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's 1,092-day UDI bonds real return 6.11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's 1,092-day UDI bonds real return 6.11 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 1,092-day UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 100.38629 UDIs and a real return of 6.11 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the 1,022-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.17 percent.
Demand this week was 2.018 billion UDIs compared to 350 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico.
The 1,820-day UDIs were assigned at a price of 100.58628 UDIs and a real return of 6.11 percent.
Two weeks ago the 1,764-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.18 percent.
Demand this week was 1.681 billion UDIs compared to 350 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico.
The daily value of the UDI can be found on MEX14.
